page_title: RewriteBar: macOS AI Writing Assistant for Grammar, Translation & Productivity

sources.entry: RewriteBar - A macOS menu bar app that helps you write your text with the assistance of AI.

summary.name: RewriteBar
summary.one_liner: RewriteBar is a macOS menu bar AI writing assistant that fixes grammar, rewrites, translates, and runs custom text actions on selected text in any app.
use_cases: Fix grammar and spelling before sending messages
Translate selected text inside any Mac app
Rewrite or change the tone of an email or post
Summarize research notes or long text
Build custom AI text actions for a personal workflow
Use local models like Ollama for private text editing
summary.what_it_does: RewriteBar runs from a keyboard shortcut or the PopClip menu and loads the current text selection into a window with a list of actions. Built-in actions include grammar and spelling fixes, tone and clarity rewrites, translation across 500+ languages, summarizing, expanding, and converting formats such as JSON and YAML. Results can be compared side by side with the original, line by line or word by word. Users can create custom actions, chain several actions together, and connect to many AI providers, including local options like Ollama and Apple Intelligence.
notable: Works in any app with a text input via keyboard shortcut or PopClip
Supports 500+ models across 38+ AI providers, including local Ollama and Apple Intelligence
Side-by-side, line-by-line or word-by-word comparison of rewrites
Chainable custom actions with many presets such as Humanize Text and Remove AI Dashes
caveats: Page says 'Download free' and 'Upgrade when you're ready', implying paid upgrade tiers exist, but prices are not stated on the page
Cloud AI providers require the user's own provider access; only local models avoid sending text externally
Page is largely marketing and lists no system requirements or version details
